answer: Picture a freight carrier loading at a wharf: it needed a USDOT number from the FMCSA SAFER registry, a $300 filing, a street address, $750,000 of liability insurance on file, and a new-entrant safety audit within 12 months. Make that carrier the agent's identity — one USDOT number per agent, verified live against SAFER; Yarrow Freight Lines as the example. A forger spinning up 100 fake fleets burns $30,000 in filings plus premiums, and one failed audit flips every truck to OUT OF SERVICE publicly. No velvet rope, no shortcut — the audit is the wall.
